static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.educational_background: Studying for a fashion design degree at a well-known school in New York
static_traits.family_status: Living alone in New York, far from family; family provides financial support
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends in New York, but not yet sharing financial Anxiety with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; opening with 'a bit nervous'; able to describe distress and trigger situations clearly; Good cooperation with the counselor; fairly coherent thinking

basic_info.main_problem: Although shopping brings inspiration for fashion design, I feel guilt and Anxiety from spending too much at fashion stores; this feeling persists and affects my life.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize the Anxiety and guilt around shopping affect my mental health and overall well-being, hence seeking counseling; hoping to find balance between the need for inspiration and financial responsibility, reducing guilt and Anxiety.
growth_experiences: Moving to New York for studies and starting to live independently, bearing new-city adaptation and academic-success pressure; shopping seen as an important way to gain design inspiration, but generating persistent guilt and Anxiety, further bringing financial insecurity and occasional conflict with the family providing financial support. Guilt especially strong at night Being alone and right after purchases, affecting sleep and attention.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on meeting family's expectations

special_situations.event: Walking into a high-end store or seeing a designer item one really likes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: To keep up with trends and gain design inspiration, I need to buy these clothes; if I do not buy, it will affect Learning and Career development
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintains inspiration through purchasing, while using budgets and shopping limits to try to balance and relieve guilt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I need these clothes to stay inspired, but this makes me look irresponsible

special_situations.event: Right after completing a purchase, especially at night when Being alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I spend money, it means I am an irresponsible person who will disappoint the family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly second-guesses every purchase, even avoids buying again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am wasting the family's money, I let them down

special_situations.event: After talking with family about money and expenses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The family's dissatisfaction means I did wrong and must control spending more strictly to meet their expectations
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strict budgeting, limiting shopping, and less sharing one's Anxiety with family or others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think me irresponsible; I have not met their expectations

special_situations.event: Considering using shopping to gain inspiration when Learning is stressful and inspiration is needed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by buying and experiencing popular trends can design competitiveness be maintained
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Justifies purchases as 'professional needs' while trying to reduce guilt with rational explanations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is important for my studies, but I may have done it wrong again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to succeed in the fashion design field and gain family's understanding and recognition.
core_conflict.fear: Fearing disappointing the family, being seen as irresponsible, and thus causing Relationship tension and financial insecurity.
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of morality and control through strict budgeting, limiting shopping, and self-reproach, trying to avoid outside criticism and conflict.

object_relations.self_representation: A supported yet unworthy consumer/Student who may disappoint the family
object_relations.object_representation: A supportive but critical family, dissatisfied with spending

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the session involves consumption habits, family support, and responsibility (such as being asked about shopping motives and family attitudes)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding others' concern as potential evaluation of 'I am irresponsible', worrying about being seen as disappointing the family again.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First affirm the pressure and distress, then in a calm, rational tone emphasize that shopping is a need for study and work; the speech is steady and the wording restrained, responding to questions as much as possible with facts and plans (budget, limiting shopping).

manifestations: Living alone after moving to New York; guilt and Anxiety after purchases markedly worsened at night when Being alone
Living independently in a new city, having autonomous consumption choices, while bearing the accompanying responsibility and pressure

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeatedly blaming oneself 'I am irresponsible, letting the family down' in sessions
Repeatedly double-checks and self-examines every purchase

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally intended to be sent outward toward himself, showing self-restraint or converting the need to request help from others into bearing it himself.
manifestations: Not yet sharing financial Anxiety with friends in New York, tending to bear pressure alone
Internalizes solutions through self-blame and restricting shopping rather than seeking external support

positive_force: Shopping can provide inspiration and industry information for design studies; has professional relevance
Willing to proactively seek counseling and try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
Able to identify typical trigger situations (high-end stores, night Being alone, talking money with family)
Has tried budgeting and limiting shopping, with some self-management awareness
negative_force: Excessive self-blame and taking others' expectations as the condition of worth (external-recognition oriented)
Cognitive biases like negating the positive and mental filtering aggravating negative emotions
Living alone and nighttime Loneliness amplifying guilt and Anxiety experiences
Financial insecurity and family conflict causing persistent stress
Adapting to a new city and success pressure raise the overall psychological load

target_behavior.behavior: Strong guilt and Anxiety in shopping-related situations, with repeated second-guessing or avoidance of purchases
antecedent: Walking into a high-end store or seeing a favorite designer item
Right after completing a purchase and at night when Being alone
After talking with family about money and expenses
target_behavior.core_reason: Under independent-living and success pressure, a moral conflict between 'shopping for inspiration' and 'being responsible to the family'; cognitive biases (negating the positive, mental filtering) making one overlook shopping's professional value, reinforcing the self-evaluation 'I am irresponsible, letting the family down'.
target_behavior.function: Escaping criticism and moral-failure feelings, temporarily lowering Anxiety and maintaining self-control and safety
target_behavior.consequence: Academic attention and Performance affected; Declining sleep quality; Strained relationships with family members; increasing financial insecurity
